DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme Disease (Erythema Migrans with early oligoarticular arthritis).

Based on your recent camping trip in Minnesota, the "bull's-eye" rash, and the sequential joint pain starting in the knee and now the wrist, this is the classic presentation of early disseminated Lyme disease. We will start you on oral doxycycline immediately to prevent further joint damage.
